svg.aria-label: Three panels, one per quality axis, each with its own 95% confidence interval (±1.96·√(p(1−p)/n) over the item count) and its own Pareto front — the dotted line, on which no model is both smaller and better. Each front is labelled at its two ends only, with a leader line where the ends sit in a crowded part of the panel; Table 2 carries every point with its footprint. The shaded band and the dashed line mark a 16 GiB card's 15 GiB budget. A point's horizontal position is its footprint — weights plus its KV cache at its context plus the 1 GiB overhead (section 2) — so a model with expensive attention sits further right than its file size suggests.Nineteen quality rows exist and sixteen are inside this frame: the horizontal axis ends at 16.6 GiB, so huihui-gemma26b-qat-abl (16.89 GiB, 0.881 mean — the highest on the page), holo4-35b-heretic-iq4xs (18.28, 0.659) and huihui-qwen36-35b-abl-q5k (25.74, 0.724) are plotted in Figure 6 and carried in Table 2, not here. The MTP and Xing4 arms have no quality row at all. Only the vertical axis changes between the three panels

svg.desc: Three panels, one per quality axis, each with its own 95% confidence interval (±1.96·√(p(1−p)/n) over the item count) and its own Pareto front — the dotted line, on which no model is both smaller and better. Each front is labelled at its two ends only, with a leader line where the ends sit in a crowded part of the panel; Table 2 carries every point with its footprint. The shaded band and the dashed line mark a 16 GiB card's 15 GiB budget. A point's horizontal position is its footprint — weights plus its KV cache at its context plus the 1 GiB overhead (section 2) — so a model with expensive attention sits further right than its file size suggests.Nineteen quality rows exist and sixteen are inside this frame: the horizontal axis ends at 16.6 GiB, so huihui-gemma26b-qat-abl (16.89 GiB, 0.881 mean — the highest on the page), holo4-35b-heretic-iq4xs (18.28, 0.659) and huihui-qwen36-35b-abl-q5k (25.74, 0.724) are plotted in Figure 6 and carried in Table 2, not here. The MTP and Xing4 arms have no quality row at all. Only the vertical axis changes between the three panels — computed from the run archive, not drawn by hand.
